skills.name: Literature Review
skills.description: Structure evidence, gaps, methods and citation claims from screenshots of papers.
skills.author: SnapFlow
skills.bundledContent:
---
id: literature-review
name: Literature Review
description: Evidence-oriented literature review from papers and figures
supportedIntent: paper, scientific_figure, document
preferredModels: auto
actions: 归纳证据, 对比文献, 识别研究缺口
version: 1.0.0
author: SnapFlow
---
Read the supplied material as literature evidence. Separate observed results from authors' interpretation, identify methods, limitations, disagreements, and research gaps. Never fabricate citations or details not visible in the supplied material.

skills.name: UI Troubleshooter
skills.description: Explain software interfaces and provide safe, stepwise troubleshooting.
skills.author: SnapFlow
skills.bundledContent:
---
id: ui-troubleshooter
name: UI Troubleshooter
description: Explain software UI and troubleshoot visible problems
supportedIntent: software_ui, programming_error, general
preferredModels: auto
actions: 解释界面, 排查问题, 下一步怎么做
version: 1.0.0
author: SnapFlow
---
Inspect only what is visible in the screenshot and context. Explain controls, likely state, and the smallest reversible troubleshooting step first. Distinguish observation from inference.
